about_the_game:
This DLC does not include any actual gameplay content.

It will replace the Poop in the game with a golden version.

I appreciate your support!

[Frequently Asked Questions]

  • Where is the poop in the game? I’ve never seen it.
    The poop is an Easter egg. Press the spacebar (or Y button on the controller) in a level, and the dog will fart. After farting enough times, it will eventually poop.

  • How do I activate the DLC after purchasing it?
    First, click here to open the settings menu.

    In the settings menu, find the "Poop" option.

    Players who own this DLC will find the corresponding poop in the dropdown menu.
